## Notes for using these lines

- "Analytical radial heat conduction (within 0.1 %)" refers to the temperature drop across the epoxy at core mid-height, with the 1D formula fed the local radial heat flow taken from the FEA. With the locally generated heat instead, the difference is 14.7 %, because heat from the insulated conductor ends flows along the copper into the core region. Be ready to explain both numbers.
- "Deflection within 7.4 %" is against the two-segment beam (core plus conductor, then bare conductor). The uniform composite beam differs by 40.3 % and is not a fair comparison for this geometry.
- "$f_1$ within 1.9 %" is against a 1D two-segment beam model. The uniform cantilever formula with composite properties differs by 46.6 %, because it places the full composite mass on the bare conductor at the tip.
